meanings.zh: 证明……正当；为……辩护；使合理化；【排版】使（文本）两端对齐
meanings.en: to show or prove to be right or reasonable; to be a good reason for; to adjust (text) so that the lines are even at both margins

coreSemantics.core: 证明合理，为行为找理由
coreSemantics.notThis: 不是简单说'解释'，而是'证明其正当性'
coreSemantics.mentalImage: 一个人站在法官面前，指着证据为自己辩解
coreSemantics.image: <svg viewBox="0 0 96 96" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect x="10" y="20" width="76" height="56" rx="4" fill="#e8eef7"/><rect x="20" y="30" width="56" height="36" fill="#fff" stroke="#4a6fa5" stroke-width="2"/><circle cx="48" cy="48" r="10" fill="#4a6fa5"/><path d="M48 58 L48 66" stroke="#4a6fa5" stroke-width="3"/><path d="M40 66 L56 66" stroke="#4a6fa5" stroke-width="3"/><circle cx="30" cy="40" r="4" fill="#f0a030"/><circle cx="66" cy="40" r="4" fill="#f0a030"/></svg>

examples.text: How can you justify spending so much money on a car?

translations.zh: 你怎么能为花这么多钱买一辆车辩解呢？

examples.text: The end does not justify the means.

translations.zh: 目的不能证明手段正当。

examples.text: Nothing can justify such rude behavior.

translations.zh: 没有什么能为这种粗鲁行为辩护。

examples.text: She was justified in complaining about the service.

translations.zh: 她抱怨服务差是有道理的。

examples.text: The results justify our confidence in the new method.

translations.zh: 结果证明我们对新方法的信心是合理的。

examples.text: Please justify the text so the margins are even.

translations.zh: 请将文本两端对齐，使页边距均匀。

wordFormation.analysis: 来自拉丁语 justus（公正的）+ -ificare（使……），经古法语 justifier 进入英语。

synonyms.nuance: 强调为某人或某观点辩护，抵御批评
只说明原因，不强调证明其正当性
常指为不合理行为找看似合理的借口

memoryAids.supplement: 常用搭配：justify doing sth；be justified in doing sth；the end justifies the means。

meanings.en: a good reason or explanation for something
able to be shown to be right or reasonable

meanings.zh: v. 挣扎；努力；艰难地做；n. 斗争；努力；难事
meanings.en: v. to try hard against difficulty; to move with great effort; n. a hard fight or effort; something difficult

coreSemantics.core: 困难 + 努力，在阻力中持续用力
coreSemantics.notThis: 不是泛指“努力”，而是“努力应对具体阻力”
coreSemantics.mentalImage: 一个人使劲推一扇卡住的门，门几乎纹丝不动
coreSemantics.image: <svg viewBox="0 0 96 96" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect x="20" y="20" width="56" height="56" rx="4" fill="#8B5A2B"/><circle cx="48" cy="48" r="6" fill="#FFD700"/><line x1="48" y1="48" x2="48" y2="76" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="4"/><path d="M30 76 L48 60 L66 76" fill="none" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="4"/></svg>

examples.text: She struggled to open the jar.
He struggled with the heavy box.

translations.zh: 他费力地搬着那个重箱子。

examples.text: The fish struggled in the net.
It was a struggle to finish the race.

translations.zh: 完成比赛是件很费力的事。
争取自由的斗争仍在继续。

examples.text: He had a struggle with his conscience.

translations.zh: 他内心进行了一番良心挣扎。

wordFormation.analysis: struggle 由中古英语 struglen 演变而来，可能源自未知词根 strug- 加频繁动作后缀 -le，与“用力扭动、挣扎”有关；词源不完全确定。

parts.meaning: 用力扭动、挣扎（词源不确定）

synonyms.nuance: 更正式，强调为达成目标而持续努力，不一定有身体挣扎
强调对抗或战斗，语气更强
强调艰苦劳动，常指体力或脑力上的长期辛苦

antonyms.nuance: 表示成功，与 struggle 的艰难过程相对
表示放松，与 struggle 的用力状态相反

memoryAids.supplement: struggle 常与 with、to do、for 搭配；名词形式常与 a、the 连用。

meanings.zh: 挣扎（第三人称单数或复数名词）
meanings.en: third-person singular of struggle; plural of struggle

meanings.zh: 挣扎了（过去式/过去分词）
meanings.en: past tense and past participle of struggle
present participle of struggle; making great efforts

meanings.zh: 等级制度；层级体系；统治集团
meanings.en: A system in which people or things are ranked one above another; a body of people ranked in order of authority.

coreSemantics.core: 按等级排列的层级体系
coreSemantics.notThis: 不是泛指'顺序'或'分类'，而是有上下级权力关系的等级结构
coreSemantics.mentalImage: 一座金字塔，每层站着不同的人，越往上人越少
coreSemantics.image: <svg viewBox="0 0 96 96" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><polygon points="48,12 88,80 8,80" fill="#e8e8e8" stroke="#333" stroke-width="3"/><line x1="28" y1="52" x2="68" y2="52" stroke="#333" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="18" y1="66" x2="78" y2="66" stroke="#333" stroke-width="2"/><circle cx="48" cy="32" r="5" fill="#333"/><circle cx="38" cy="46" r="4" fill="#333"/><circle cx="58" cy="46" r="4" fill="#333"/><circle cx="28" cy="60" r="3" fill="#333"/><circle cx="48" cy="60" r="3" fill="#333"/><circle cx="68" cy="60" r="3" fill="#333"/></svg>

examples.text: She quickly climbed the corporate hierarchy.

translations.zh: 她迅速攀上了公司的等级阶梯。

examples.text: The church has a strict hierarchy of authority.

translations.zh: 教会有严格的权力等级制度。

examples.text: In the animal hierarchy, the alpha male dominates.

translations.zh: 在动物等级体系中，首领雄性占主导地位。

examples.text: The company flattened its management hierarchy last year.

translations.zh: 公司去年精简了管理层的等级结构。

examples.text: There is a clear hierarchy of needs in psychology.

translations.zh: 心理学中有一个清晰的需求层次。

examples.text: He refused to accept the social hierarchy of his time.

translations.zh: 他拒绝接受当时的社会等级制度。

wordFormation.analysis: From Greek hieros 'sacred' + arkhein 'to rule', via medieval Latin hierarchia 'rule of a high priest'. The -y is a noun-forming suffix from Latin -ia.

synonyms.nuance: 更强调排列顺序，不一定含权力上下级
口语化，常指群体中的实际地位高低

antonyms.nuance: 强调地位平等，无上下级之分

memoryAids.supplement: 常见搭配：corporate hierarchy, social hierarchy, hierarchy of needs, climb the hierarchy.

meanings.zh: 等级制度的；按等级划分的
meanings.en: relating to a hierarchy; arranged in ranks

meanings.zh: 教主；高级教士；等级体系中的高层
meanings.en: a chief priest; a high-ranking person in a hierarchy
